description.text: Submodel carrying simulation properties for each System / Flow / Work / Call, plus the embedded SimulationResult snapshot (meta + KPI groups). Previously embedded under TechnicalData; relocated for AAS standard SM separation.
Submodel mit Simulationseigenschaften je System / Flow / Work / Call sowie eingebettetem SimulationResult-Snapshot (Meta + KPI-Gruppen). Zuvor in TechnicalData; gemäß AAS-Standardtrennung verlagert.
System / Flow / Work / Call 별 시뮬레이션 속성 + SimulationResult 박제(메타 + KPI 그룹) 를 함께 보유. 이전엔 TechnicalData 안에 있었으나 AAS 표준 SM 분리 정책에 따라 이전됨.
